from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs')

program='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    cross_row = next(r for r in range(rows) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for c in range(cols)))
    cross_col = next(c for c in range(cols) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(rows)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                continue
            dr = abs(r - cross_row)
            dc = abs(c - cross_col)
            if dr % 2 == 0:
                colored = (dc % 2 == 0) or (dc % 2 == 1 and dc < dr)
            else:
                colored = (dc % 2 == 0 and dc > dr)
            if colored:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-66ca43b1.py'; p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'),globals())
print(p)
